what_happened: On a multi-lane highway with no hazard ahead, the policy took over and braked hard for no reason (16.9 → 8.1 m/s) while steering left into the next lane. Its front hit vehicle 1, which was travelling in that lane just ahead and to the left. The human driver had kept going straight in the lane. The hard braking also got the ego rear-ended, but the front collision came first.

After handoff the ego braked hard on the highway (29 to 13 m/s) and steered steadily left, away from its planned path and the recorded trajectory. It crossed the leftmost lane line onto the median shoulder even though the route command was RIGHT. At the moment it went off-road, actor 40 overlapped the ego; this follows from the ego's own sudden braking and drift (a rear contact was also logged during the run).

After handoff on a straight multi-lane highway, the policy braked hard for no clear reason (17→8 m/s while the gap to the lead car was growing) and steered left out of its lane. Its front-left corner hit actor 1, which was passing in the adjacent left lane. A follower also rear-ended the ego because of the sudden braking.

After handoff on a multi-lane highway, the policy braked hard for no clear reason (17 to 9 m/s while the lead was over 20 m ahead) and steered left out of its lane, away from the recorded path that went straight. Its front then hit actor 1, which was traveling in the adjacent left lane just ahead and to the left of the ego.

On a multi-lane highway, the policy braked hard (28 to 13 m/s) and got rear-ended before 5.9 s. It also steered left, away from the recorded path on its right, even though the route command was RIGHT. By 7.9 s it had drifted onto the left shoulder by the barrier, about 5 m off the recorded path, and ended up offroad with front contact against actor 40.

On a multi-lane highway with a STRAIGHT command, the ego's planned path kept bending left. It drifted out of its lane, about 1.3 m left of the recorded path, and its front hit actor 41, which was travelling in the adjacent left lane. The lead truck stayed 17 m or more ahead the whole time, and the camera view was clean before impact.

On a straight multi-lane highway, the policy's planned path bent left toward the adjacent lane while the ego slowed from 6.8 to 4.1 m/s, and the ego's front hit actor 41, a white pickup coming up alongside in the left lane. The lead vehicle stayed 17 m or more ahead the whole time, and the human driver in the recording kept straight in the lane.

On a multi-lane highway with the STRAIGHT command, the policy slowed from 6.8 to 4.5 m/s even though the lead truck was well ahead. Its planned path bent left toward the next lane, and the ego drifted about 1.3 m left of the recorded trajectory. Its front then hit actor 41, a white pickup passing on the left in that lane.

On a multi-lane highway, the human driver moved right, but the policy braked hard (28.8 to 13.4 m/s) and steered left. It went past the leftmost lane edge into the median/guardrail area and was flagged offroad at 7.8 s, while the route command was RIGHT. The hard braking had already gotten the ego rear-ended earlier, and actor 10 was alongside at the end, but the failure is the ego leaving the road.

After handoff on a straight multi-lane highway, the ego braked hard (28 to 12.7 m/s), was rear-ended along the way, and steered left away from the recorded path. The route command had changed to RIGHT, but the ego crossed the left lane edge onto the median shoulder by the guardrail and went off-road about 5 m from the recorded trajectory.

Even though the command was RIGHT, the ego moved left away from the recorded path (5.1 m off by the end). Its front hit actor 28, which was in the lane to its left at 7.4 s and was 4.2 m ahead in the ego's path at 8.4 s; the ego was still doing about 6.7 m/s. Something also hit the ego's rear, but the front collision came first.

The ego was in stop-and-go queued traffic and drifted about 2.8 m to the side of the recorded path, ending up straddling the lane line. It kept creeping forward, slowing from 2.7 to 0.3 m/s without ever stopping, and its front corner touched the rear of stopped car 24 just ahead and to its left. The camera view is smeared but still shows that car clearly, so the policy simply didn't stop short of a stationary car ahead.

On a multi-lane highway with a RIGHT command, the policy slowed hard (26.5 to 12.9 m/s) and steered left, away from the recorded path that kept right. It drifted across the lanes to the left edge of the carriageway by the median barrier and went offroad at 8.1 s, about 5 m off the recorded trajectory. The rear-end contact was a separate event, most likely a vehicle behind hitting the ego after its unprompted hard braking; it did not cause the departure from the road.

On a clear highway with a STRAIGHT and then RIGHT command, the policy braked hard for no reason (29 to 13 m/s) and was rear-ended. It also steered left, away from the recorded path that went right. By 7.7s it had crossed the left lane edge onto the left shoulder or grass, and actor 40 was overlapping it alongside.

The command was RIGHT, but after handoff the ego slowed and drifted left of the recorded path (about 5 m off by 8.2 s), into the next lane to the left. Actor 28 was passing on that side, and the ego's front hit it as it came alongside and pulled ahead, about 4 m away.

In slow, stop-and-go traffic the ego drifted left onto the lane line, about 2.9 m off the recorded path, with its planned path lined up behind car 24 in the next lane over. While edging across, it crept into the rear corner of car 24 at about 0.1 m/s and registered a front collision.

In stop-and-go traffic, with the route command STRAIGHT, the ego slowed from 1.8 to 0.1 m/s and stayed 4.6 m or more behind actor 24 ahead in its lane. Meanwhile it drifted about 2.9 m off the recorded path, angling its nose right toward the next lane, and made a low-speed front contact at 10.1 s, most likely with the car at its front right (actor 21 / 23). The map doesn't clearly show which actor it hit or where they overlap.

The ego was slowing in a queue behind car 24 and stopped about 4.6 m behind it, so it did not hit the lead. While creeping it angled right toward the lane line, about 2.9 m off the recorded path, and at near-zero speed its front-right clipped the stationary vehicle 23 in the adjacent right lane.
